prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1409; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are far more than the damage needs, about three times a normal estimate.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The right rear quarter panel and rear bumper cover show scuffing, a cracked lower reflector, and a dented rear door skin consistent with a sideswipe along the passenger side during a lane change. The pattern of contact lines up with the reported impact, and no prior damage to these panels is known. The labor hours on this estimate run roughly three times what a repair of this scope would normally require, so the figure is under review. Two similar charges posted on the same day are also being checked before approval. Recommended plan: replace the reflector and bumper cover, repair the door skin, and refinish the affected panels, with the labor revised to match the actual scope.
